scope: Bounded P2 repair of terminal failure precedence in the independent standard-library supervisor. Invented executable stubs and pure dictionaries only; no historical source imports, measurement fixtures, evaluators, observations, or games.
execution_owner: Parent coordinator runs the combined suite; this worker does not run tests.
prior_evidence: The pre-third-repair snapshot and all earlier receipts, including the prior 129-test receipt, remain unchanged. S16's former expectation that cleanup trouble downgrades resource_incomplete to execution_incomplete is incorrect and is prospectively corrected here; no earlier pass count is relabeled.

interface.primary_outcome: Immutable pre-cleanup status and reason, including an ordinary zero child exit when applicable.
interface.secondary_failures: Ordered phase/status/reason records for cleanup, deferred output persistence, subreaper restoration, and final budget failures; exception type/message are included when available.
interface.terminal_status: Top-level status/reason preserve existing integrity or resource failures against later lower-severity problems. Child returncode/exit_code/signal remain independent evidence. A secondary failure after otherwise successful child completion still prevents completed status.

finite_cases.case: A tiny sleeping stub reaches the reduced cell-wall bound, then one injected cleanup-signal failure occurs. Require unchanged primary and terminal resource_incomplete/cell_wall_limit, a separate process_cleanup_unconfirmed secondary record, explicit cleanup uncertainty, and no surviving stub PID. Change only the formerly incorrect downgrade assertions; preserve the other S16 subcases.

After a stub reaches the reduced cell-wall cap and normal group cleanup completes, restore the real subreaper setting and inject a restoration error. Require the primary resource cause to remain and a separate restoration failure.

A stub prints a prefix and reaches the reduced cell-wall cap. Inject the deferred log write failure after group cleanup. Require unchanged primary resource cause, explicit persistence failure and output gap, and intact child signal/exit evidence.

A stub exits zero, then a restoration error is reported after the actual setting is restored. Require primary completed/child_exit_zero, terminal execution_incomplete, separate restoration failure, and exit_code zero without falsely claiming a completed supervised run.

finite_cases.test: New zero-exit plus final output-budget regression
finite_cases.case: A stub prints a prefix and exits zero. A synthetic shared-budget callback permits running checks but rejects nonempty output only after real group cleanup. Require primary zero-exit completion, terminal resource_incomplete, a separate final-budget failure, and a disclosed retained-prefix gap.

Seed invented primary outcome dictionaries for integrity_invalid, resource_incomplete, execution_incomplete, and completed. Add finite lower/equal/higher severity secondary failures; assert integrity remains dominant, earlier resource reasons survive later resource/infrastructure problems, primary evidence stays unchanged, and failed preservation cannot turn success into completed.

regression_boundary: The existing S01-S16 suite remains in scope with only S16's incorrect cleanup-downgrade expectation corrected. Add exactly five test methods for P2-02 through P2-06. No fault cases beyond this finite list are authorized by this plan.
